items.title: Marty Napoleon interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York, New York, January 16, 1999
items.q: he had Sol Yaged on clarinet, a young kid about 19 years old, Dick Brady on trombone, Tony Spargo on drums

ctx.x: The Memphis Five was it called?

It was called the Memphis Five. It was a great band. But a funny thing is, we went up to Boston for two weeks and we played at Mrs. Donahue’s place, it was great, and he and I had a little falling out because he had Sol Yaged on clarinet, a young kid about 19 years old, Dick Brady on trombone, Tony Spargo on drums, who was fantastic. Did you ever hear that name?
